description: On the mission's last full sim day, the crew's shared nightly 'petals and thorns' reflection converged on the same sentiment from all five members: reluctance to leave, and a sense that the mission's remaining challenges ('thorns') were really evidence of how much they valued the experience ('petals in disguise').
lesson: Recorded by the crew itself as a marker that 'this experience has been valuable and worthwhile for every last one of us' -- a different phenomenon (end-of-mission nostalgia/reluctance-to-leave) than, but a loosely comparable positive-cohesion signal to, the marked morale improvement logged for FMARS-C18-2025's own Sol 6 (FMARS-C18-2025-EVT003, early-mission stress resolving into cohesion) -- flagged here as an analogy, not an equivalence.
source_citation: SRC-fmars-c19-2026-mission-updates, sol-9 report: 'we realized that all our thorns today were all but identical, and that those thorns are petals in disguise. We all wish we could stay here longer. This means that this experience has been valuable and worthwhile for every last one of us.'
